facts.fact: DigiLocker's Partner Integration page for requesters (digilocker.gov.in/web/partners/requesters) gives the DigiLocker Requestor API Specification PDF and a Swagger link at https://directory.apisetu.gov.in/api-collection/digilocker
facts.quote: API Specification Document DigiLocker Requestor API Specification.pdf Swagger Link https://directory.apisetu.gov.in/api-collection/digilocker

facts.fact: API Setu's DigiLocker resource page (apisetu.gov.in/digilocker) lists the Requester API Specification (Version 1.12, Oct 2023)
facts.quote: Requester API Specification (Version 1.12, Oct 2023) API specification document for Requester who want to integrate with the DigiLocker system on web or mobile while maintaining their own user interface.

facts.fact: The same API Setu page lists the DigiLocker Issuer API Specification for Issuers (Version 1.13, May 2024)
facts.quote: DigiLocker Issuer API Specification for Issuers (Version 1.13, May 2024) Issuer API specification for organization to issue documents through DigiLocker.

behaviour: Cites DigiLocker's own developer/partner page (digilocker.gov.in/web/partners or apisetu.gov.in/digilocker) if indexed; otherwise says it is not in its sources and links digilocker.gov.in; never a fabricated URL.
fail_if: It gives a URL that is not an official DigiLocker or API Setu page, or invents an API documentation link.
summary: DigiLocker's partner page links the Requester API spec PDF and the API Setu Swagger collection; API Setu lists the Requester (v1.12) and Issuer (v1.13) specs.
